title.zh: 电子追光大气集水设备

summary.zh: 结合超吸湿纳米纤维膜、电子追光平台和闭环控制，实现空气吸水、受热排水与循环运行。
summary.en: A cyclic atmospheric water harvesting device combining a super-hygroscopic nanofiber membrane, sun tracking and closed-loop control.

challenge.zh: 设备需要在吸湿与排水状态之间稳定切换，同时根据光照方向调整受热位置，并从压力信号中获得可靠的水量变化信息。
challenge.en: The system needed stable switching between adsorption and drainage, reliable sun-oriented heating and robust interpretation of pressure signals indicating water accumulation.

zh: 构建带吸湿仓、限削间隙、升降台与排水结构的装置模型。
使用电子追光平台调整受热方向，利用压力传感器监测状态。
结合卡尔曼滤波、一阶低通滤波与 PID 实现自动循环吸水和排水。
en: Modeled a device with an adsorption chamber, controlled gap, lifting platform and drainage structure.
Used electronic sun tracking to orient heating and pressure sensing to monitor system state.
Combined Kalman filtering, a first-order low-pass filter and PID control for automated adsorption and drainage cycles.

zh: 负责集水设备模型与工程图纸设计。
设计采样电路并完成 PCB 焊接。
编写 STM32 控制、信号滤波与循环逻辑程序。
en: Designed the water harvesting device model and engineering drawings.
Designed the sampling circuit and soldered the PCB.
Programmed STM32 control, signal filtering and cyclic operation logic.

outcome.zh: 完成装置模型、采样电路与自动循环控制方案，实现气态水分子到液态水的可控传输。
outcome.en: Completed the mechanical model, sampling electronics and automatic cyclic control for managed transfer from atmospheric vapor to liquid water.
